infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Urban Helpers needs your location to show your professional's route and pinpoint doorstep service addresses.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Urban Helpers tracks your daily steps and physical activity.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Urban Helpers requires camera access to upload prescription and medical record documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Urban Helpers requires photo gallery access to upload profile pictures and health documents.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Urban Helpers connects with your smartwatch to synchronize live pulse rate, step count, and fitness vitals.
